# FG-REPO-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`repo-storage`](../../ops/runbooks/repo-storage.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `unreadable_or_unwritable_storage_is_storage_io_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの保存先の読み書きに失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: Reading or writing repository storage failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Gagal membaca atau menulis penyimpanan repositori. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A file-system operation on the storage root failed: permission denied, disk full, or an I/O error while creating or inspecting a repository directory.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `operation` (`inspect`, `create_shard`, `create_temp`, `rename`, `cleanup`), `repo_id` when known, and the OS error in `source`. `reason=deadline` (with `operation`): the provisioning job's deadline ran out during that file-system step (the job retries); `operation=doctor_storage reason=check_timeout`: `forge doctor` `repositories.storage` did not finish its walk over the ready repositories in 60 s (`checked`, `missing`, `other` say how far it got) — a slow or hung storage volume. Check free space (`df -h <root>`), ownership and mode of the storage root, and the kernel log for I/O errors.

## 対処 (fix)

Free disk space, restore ownership of the storage root to the forge service user, or replace the failing volume.
